title: Untrusted current-environment platform runtime observation
description: One machine's own report of its platform runtime behavior. It describes the single supported row that matches the environment it ran in, and it is never authority: a release claim requires an owner-mapped environment whose evidence a provider has attested.

label.description: Fixed label that keeps the report from being read as authority.

source_revision.description: Revision of the source the observation was taken from.

matrix_digest.description: Digest of the abstract supported-target manifest the row came from.

contract_digest.description: Digest of the foundation contract the deadlines came from.

triple.description: Exact target triple of the single row this report describes.

operating_system.description: Operating system the observation actually ran on.

architecture.description: Architecture the observation actually ran on.

outcomes.description: One entry per behavior the row requires.

policy.description: Outcome of the deterministic policy evaluation, which runs for every row.

real.description: Outcome of the real behavior, which runs only on the row matching this environment.

reason.description: Why a real behavior was not run.
